title: TOP 10 REASONS TO TRAVEL SOLO!
description:
As much as travelling with a group of people can be ridiculously fun and exciting, there are also a lot of great reasons to Travel Solo! We've each done group travel as well as embarked on our own solo adventures, and both have their ups and downs.  We'll share with you are top 10 reasons to travel solo, in hopes to show you that you've got nothing to be afraid of and everything to gain... remember, you'll never actually be alone anyways!!
